description: Issue #962, the negative direction of `heritage-value-of-key-reader-across-a-newline`. That fixture requires the phantom `ol-unmatched-paren` raised on CORRECTLY MATCHED parentheses to disappear; a fix that simply stopped emitting the diagnostic would satisfy it while destroying real error reporting. Here the `(` is genuinely never closed, in the very shape the fix now carries the parse through (the reader split across a newline), and exactly one `ol-unmatched-paren` must still be reported at the `(` itself -- measured at [16,7]-[16,8] with `params.delimiter` `(`. `produce()` returns parse diagnostics without running `check()` when parsing produced any (`scripts/harness/index.mjs`), so this expectation is the parse-stage diagnostic alone. The reader operates on a dict, so Heritage also needs Data (`spec/conformance.md:305`).
